title: My Uncle and the Rocket Launch
body:
My uncle was watching a SpaceX rocket video when his girlfriend walked into the room.

"Why are you watching that again?" she asked.

"I'm checking whether their rockets can really go up," he answered.

She laughed. "You should ask them to take your investment with them next time."

My uncle tried not to laugh. "I'm serious. I lost a lot."

"I know," she said. "That's why I'm making jokes. You've looked unhappy for days."

Then she sat next to him.

"It is normal to feel bad when something does not go as planned," she said. "But one bad investment does not decide your whole future."

My uncle nodded slowly.

"Do you really think things will get better?" he asked.

"I don't know," she answered. "But I know worrying all day won't make them better."

That evening, they watched the rocket launch together, and my uncle finally enjoyed it instead of thinking only about money.

essays.sampleAnswer: I agree with this idea. Worrying does not solve problems; it only makes us feel more tired and stressed. Instead, it is better to talk to someone or take action to fix the problem.

essays.q: Describe a time when you felt disappointed about something that did not go as planned. What did you do?
essays.sampleAnswer: Once, I studied hard for a test but got a low score. I felt very disappointed at first. But I talked to my teacher and made a new study plan, and my next score was much better.

essays.q: Why do you think the uncle finally enjoyed watching the rocket launch at the end of the story?
